phase_name: CHGR-001 Sec.26 Integrity-Reference Binding Contract Clarification
summary: Phase 146K independently reconstructed the human_governance_record.integrity_ref / governance_record_integrity.payload_digest construction-time digest cycle Phase 146J established (CHGR-REQ-197 vs CHGR-REQ-203), directly from references.schema.json, digest.schema.json, human_governance_record.schema.json, governance_record_integrity.schema.json, and direct reads of governance/publication/record.py and governance/verification.py, independently of Phase 146J's own report text. Confirmed by direct substitution that no non-recursive, deterministic construction can populate both digests without weakening a separately frozen invariant (CHGR-REQ-197's uniform canonical-payload-hash rule, or the immutability-after-finalization discipline). Evaluated six candidate binding models (A: final integrity digest in integrity_ref -- rejected, genuine SHA-256 fixed-point equation, not constructible; B: identity-only reference with nullable digest -- rejected, requires a larger schema migration than Model C for an equivalent outcome; C: directed one-way integrity binding, identity plus reciprocal payload_digest -- selected; D: projected-digest reference -- rejected, creates a second hidden digest meaning under the same field name; E: external bundle/envelope digest -- rejected, disproportionate redesign; F: none found beyond A-E) against all twelve criteria the authorizing prompt specifies. Selected Model C, independently discovered to already be the reciprocal check the currently deployed verifier performs (verification.py line 452, integrity.payload_digest != declared_digest) without prior contractual authority or duplicate-match protection. Froze CHGR-001 v1.3 (Sec.30, CHGR-REQ-210 through CHGR-REQ-216): integrity_ref identifies its sibling by record_id/record_family only, with its record_digest field remaining schema-required but reference-authoring-time-only and non-authoritative for identity binding (CHGR-REQ-210); the reciprocal payload_digest==human_governance_record.record_digest equality is the authoritative anti-substitution proof (CHGR-REQ-211); confirmation_evidence_ref/provenance_ref instead gain full exact-digest enforcement, since no cycle constrains either (CHGR-REQ-212); a uniform duplicate-match fail-closed rule applies to all three reference types, forbidding first-match selection (CHGR-REQ-213); the nine-step construction order record.py already follows is frozen as binding (CHGR-REQ-214); every already-produced Chapter 146 bundle is classified valid under the clarified semantics without migration or regeneration (CHGR-REQ-215); and an explicit no-narrowing clause confirms CHGR-REQ-001 through CHGR-REQ-209 are unaffected (CHGR-REQ-216). Requires zero schema, manifest, fixture, or verification-code changes -- confirmed via git diff (no output under src/pcae/schema_resources/chgr/** or src/pcae/governance/**). Full detail in docs/PHASE_146K_CHGR001_SECTION_26_INTEGRITY_REFERENCE_BINDING_CONTRACT_CLARIFICATION.md.

validation_results.result: Independently reproduced the digest cycle by direct substitution of references.schema.json's artifact_reference required fields, CHGR-REQ-197 (governance_record_integrity.record_digest computed over its own canonical payload including payload_digest), CHGR-REQ-203 (payload_digest = the referencing human_governance_record's own final record_digest), and the same record's own record_digest computation (which includes integrity_ref, a required, non-excluded field) -- a genuine, non-degenerate SHA-256 fixed-point equation, confirmed independently of Phase 146J's own report prose

validation_results.name: phase_146k_construction_verification_code_read

validation_results.name: phase_146k_model_evaluation
validation_results.result: Evaluated Models A-F against all twelve selection criteria (mathematical constructibility, determinism, fail-closed behavior, anti-substitution, anti-duplicate-ambiguity, independent self-digest preservation, cycle avoidance, offline verification, Coordinator ownership preservation, no execution-capability change, minimal schema migration, clear operator/auditor semantics). Selected Model C (directed one-way integrity binding); rejected A (mathematically not constructible), B and D (larger schema-migration footprint or hidden digest-meaning ambiguity than Model C), E (disproportionate redesign); no Model F found beyond A-E

validation_results.name: phase_146k_foundational_reference_model_reconciliation
